title: Alarm and geofencing behavior
summary: The topic centers on alarm activation and geofencing, with one positive suggestion for a menu option to avoid unnecessary alarm triggers and two fragments that only mention the alarm going off without clear evaluation.

positive.summary: Positive feedback highlights an easy menu-option idea for safely avoiding unwanted alarm activation in a garage and simplifying trunk access.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions state that the vehicle alarm briefly goes off or that the security alarm will go off, but they do not provide enough context to judge satisfaction.

limitations: The sample is very small, with only one clearly positive review and two undetermined mentions.
Most fragments are brief and lack context about when or why the alarm activates.
The topic is narrow and partly based on fragmentary mentions, so broader conclusions about customer sentiment are not supported.
